snippet.title: WHISMIE - official teaser trailer | PC Game
snippet.description:
STEAM Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3401710/WHISMIE/?beta=0

STORY:

Welcome to WHISMIE LIVE — an innovative program of social rehabilitation, where human pain turns into a spectacle for millions of viewers.

Each participant connects to a neural device that immerses their mind into a world created by artificial intelligence — a reflection of their own fears, memories, and guilt.

Locations are different for everyone: for Emily, the new participant, this virtual reality becomes her childhood home… exactly as she remembers it.

The process of immersion happens gradually. Under the curator’s supervision, Emily relives her past — first peaceful memories, then distorted visions where love exists next to horror.

Each new level brings her closer to the question she’s afraid to hear the answer to — even from herself.

And when the line between therapy and punishment begins to blur, Emily must find out — is she really being cured, or has she become part of someone’s show?
